description: Lists the business locations under an account (Business Information API). Each location's name is locations/{id} — that id feeds locationId everywhere else (including the Performance API and, together with the account id, the v4 reviews/posts tools). totalSize is only present when filter is set. Fields are limited by readMask; ask for metadata to get mapsUri/placeId/newReviewUri.

accountId.description: Account id — bare "123" or "accounts/123" (get it from list_accounts).

filter.description: Filter expression, e.g. 'title="Coffee Corner"'. Also enables totalSize in the response.

orderBy.description: Sort order, e.g. "title" or "title, storeCode desc".

readMask.description: Comma-separated FieldMask of Location fields to return, e.g. "name,title,storefrontAddress,regularHours,metadata". The API requires it; omit to use the default "name,title,storefrontAddress,phoneNumbers,categories,websiteUri,metadata".

name: list_locations
title: List locations of an account
